blocks.x: Regulatory Compliance Automation: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Controls live in spreadsheets; evidence is assembled in panic; every framework audit restarts from zero; DORA/PCI/AI-Act expectations keep growing.
Our approach

We implement the unified control register with continuous testing and automated evidence collection, mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS 4.0, DORA and privacy regimes — audits become sampling against a live control plane.
Components

items: Automated control checks with failing-control workflows
Artifacts tied to systems, timestamps, owners
DORA, PCI DSS 4.0, AI Act, privacy-specific programs
Auditor-facing evidence views with scope selection

blocks.x: Platform stack

The solution runs on Dataq Compass and Dataq Sentinel: Model governance your risk committee and regulator can review. Security controls for people, machines and models, with evidence collected continuously.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness
Prerequisites are modest and named: governed access to the core data sources, a named executive sponsor and a control owner, and a sandbox where the proof can run on real records.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
DORA-grade resilience posture: third-party and incident evidence automated

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Technology & SaaS. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Programs run on the fixed rhythm below, chosen so progress is legible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
